$comment: What .github/workflows/soak.yml runs: each entry runs `suite` on every runner in `os`, in `jobs` fresh jobs per runner (default 1), each running the suite `repeat` times (default 1; e2e passes it to Playwright as --repeat-each). `args` are added to the suite's command.

Suites: unit, integration, e2e, rust, windows-installer, windows-app, windows-direct, windows-quality, windows-obs, preflight, scripts, desktop-test, desktop-dmg, apt (see scripts/ci/soak-run.mjs for each command).

Edit this file on the branch, push, then add the `soak` label to the pull request (remove and add it again for another soak). Runners: GitHub Free runs 20 jobs at once, 5 of them macOS; the rest queue.

TEMPORARY (WP7, reverted after the soak): the E2E flake hunt. Every project 10 times on Ubuntu and macOS (2 jobs x 5) with one retry and flaky = failed, and barely-delivers 20 times on Ubuntu without retries (ubuntu-latest, which is 24.04: one entry per suite and runner label).
